description: Awesome Sustainable Technology (open-source sustainability projects) is a curated catalogue listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects, published or maintained by Protontypes (Awesome Sustainable Technology community). It lists several hundred open-source projects and datasets for sustainability, grouped into renewable energy sources, energy storage, grids, energy consumption in buildings, mobility and industry, energy-system modelling and analysis, emissions, ecosystems, water and waste. Coverage: worldwide, not geographically bound. Only the energy, storage, grid, consumption, assessment, water and waste sections are catalogued from it; the ecosystem, ocean, ice, air, soil, emissions and community sections are outside the scope of this catalogue. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0 for the list itself; the listed projects carry their own licences. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding open-source tools for energy and infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
